thread:
maya: Heads up — I sketched a criticality matrix that ties customer signals (active users, error rate, spend) to pre-GA handoff gates. Need alignment on owners for SLA / docs / support / monitoring / pricing. TL;DR: high / medium / low tiers with different gating bars. Link: https://redwood.atlassian/handbook/handoff-matrix :eyes:

ajay: Can you paste the matrix here quickly? Need to vet capacity gating numbers (RPS per tenant, 95p latency) before we sign off on SLAs.

maya: Pasted quick matrix inline: 
```
Tier | Active users | Error rate | Spend | Gate
High | >10k DAU     | <=2%       | >$50k | SLA + runbook + billing validated
Med  | 1k-10k        | <=5%       | $5k-$50k | Docs + monitoring + billing sanity
Low  | <1k           | best-effort| <$5k  | Basic docs
```

elena: prodops note: +1 on tiers. For monitoring readiness we need per-route dashboards, alert burn-in, and runbooks rehearsed. I can own monitoring & runbook validation.

noah: finops: pricing readiness needs a validated cost model (cost per 1k tokens) and a pricing playbook + migration path for pilot customers. I'll own pricing playbook.

ajay: eng: I'll own SLA (latency & availability) and infra fallbacks. Two asks: add a fallback model variant + a clear capacity/burst test plan. Also need a quantization compatibility doc for Dedicated customers.

lia: support: I'll own support runbooks and escalation matrix. Need a 24/7 coverage plan for the top 5 high-tier customers and an SLO->support mapping.

maya: Proposed owner map (please confirm): SLA -> ajay, Docs -> maya, Support -> lia, Monitoring -> elena, Pricing -> noah.

maya: Proposed gating criteria (draft):
- High: error rate <=2%, 95p latency <=300ms, billing validated, runbook rehearsed
- Medium: error rate <=5%, 95p latency <=500ms, billing sanity checked
- Low: best-effort; documented limits

ajay: confirmed, but add explicit burst/circuit-breaker thresholds and a load test script. Example we can run: `k6 run burst_test.js` or `ab -n 10000 -c 200`. I'll pick and own load tests.

elena: I'll schedule alerting burn-in and two simulated incident drills next week to validate runbooks.

noah: I'll finalize the pricing playbook and run cost-per-token validation against the Dedicated pricing matrix.

lia: I'll draft the support rota and SLO->support mapping doc, and coordinate with oncall.

maya: OK owners confirmed. Action items with ETAs:
- ajay: load test + SLA page (ETA Tue)
- elena: dashboards + incident drills (ETA Wed)
- noah: pricing playbook + cost validation (ETA Fri)
- lia: runbooks + oncall schedule (ETA Thu)
- maya: docs + rollout checklist + customer signal thresholds (ETA Tue)

maya: Any objections? If none I'll push tickets into the release board and tag owners.

ajay: no objections. Note: we should define exact "customer signal" thresholds that trigger throttling/circuit-breakers; I'll add a PR with suggested thresholds.

deploy-bot: deploy-checker: release board updated — handoff-criticality tickets created (#PROD-4321, #PROD-4322, #PROD-4323).

maya: :thumbsup: thanks everyone. Let's reconvene after the burn-in drills and incident sims to re-evaluate gating.
